name: fiber-ai
description: Fiber AI MCP extension. fiber-ai-v2 exposes auto-generated direct tools for the top ~10 priority operations (API-key auth). fiber-ai-v3 exposes direct tools for every public operation with compact descriptions (OAuth / SSO auth). fiber-ai-core exposes meta-tools (search_endpoints, list_tag_packs, list_all_endpoints, get_endpoint_details_full, call_operation) over every public operation.
